messages:
Anna (support): Liam from Acme just pinged in the signup flow — they signed up, completed org + billing, but the SDK calls are returning 403. He says the console shows a key created. Can someone help triage?
Liam (AcmeOps): yeah hitting this from our side. curl returns 403 with \"error: project_not_found\". Console lists key id sk_live_abc123 but when we use it we get: 
```
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
{
  \"error\": { \"type\": \"invalid_request\", \"message\": \"project not found or missing permission\" }
}
```
Anna (support): thanks. Can you paste the exact curl you used and the org/project ids from the console?
Liam (AcmeOps): sure —
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"text-embed-001\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Console shows org_id: org-58f, project_id: proj-58f-sandbox — we expected prod project proj-58f-prod. The key was supposed to be in prod.
Priya (cust-success): timeline: signed up 09:04, payment ok, they clicked \"create project\" (prod). Our onboarding job should create prod project & key. Is it possible it defaulted to sandbox?
provision-bot: Provision job 789012 completed. Created API key sk_live_abc123 assigned to project proj-58f-sandbox.
Ben (onboarding): Hmm. I see the onboarding job ran but I don't recall a step that picks sandbox over prod. @Rafael can you check worker logs for job 789012?
Rafael (eng-infra): pulling logs now. Quick note: there was a transient error in 789012 where the project-create call returned 202 and our worker retried with fallback to the \"default_project\" config. Found this in worker log: 
```
2026-03-15T09:04:21Z WARN provision-worker[789012] - project-create received 202, no exact match for variant 'prod' in response -> falling back to default_project=proj-58f-sandbox
2026-03-15T09:04:22Z INFO provision-worker[789012] - api-key created sk_live_abc123 -> project proj-58f-sandbox
```
Rafael (eng-infra): Looks like the upstream project-service returned 202 and an empty variants array for this org due to a race when the org's prod project hadn't fully materialized. Worker code fell back to default_project.
Maya (sre): Any quick patch? We need to avoid assigning keys to sandbox for paid customers. Customers can access sandbox tokens and hit lower quotas too.
Ben (onboarding): Short-term: we can reassign Liam's key to the prod project and re-run the provisioning check. Longer-term: change retry logic to wait and verify project-create success instead of falling back.
Rafael (eng-infra): I can reassign DB-side now. Doing update.
provision-bot: Reassign action invoked by Rafael. Previous mapping sk_live_abc123 -> proj-58f-sandbox. Updating to proj-58f-prod.
Rafael (eng-infra): done. Confirmed key now attached to proj-58f-prod.
Anna (support): Liam — can you try the curl again (same key)?
Liam (AcmeOps): retrying...
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_abc123\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"text-embed-001\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
Liam (AcmeOps): success 200 and returned vector. thanks! :tada:
Priya (cust-success): I'll message them and confirm they can proceed. Thanks Rafael and Ben.
Maya (sre): To prevent recurrence: I propose these action items — 1) change worker to poll project-service up to N seconds before fallback; 2) add an assert that paid onboarding never maps to sandbox; 3) add monitoring alert when provisioning assigns keys to default_project.
Ben (onboarding): Agree. I'll open a follow-up PR for worker behavior and add test coverage for the race.
Rafael (eng-infra): Filed infra ticket INF-4321 with patch plan. Patch will be merged and deployed by EOD tomorrow.
Anna (support): Logged support ticket SUP-10244 and sent a note to customer. Marking thread resolved once Priya confirms no other issues.
Priya (cust-success): confirmed by email at 10:12AM — all good. Closing.
Liam (AcmeOps): appreciate the fast turnaround, cheers.
Anna (support): :heart: will add postmortem follow-up to weekly onboarding retro.
Maya (sre): final note — added a short-term alert rule: count(provisioning_assigned_default_project{env=\"prod\"}) > 0 -> pager. We'll mute for one hour to avoid duplicates while Rafael applies fix.
Rafael (eng-infra): patch deployed, monitors green.
Anna (support): resolved.
